title: CASINO VAL-U-PAK
description:
This was the culmination of all my console card game projects, a single "casino" game with account management, a persistent bank balance, and four games to play: Blackjack, Go Fish, Craps, and Irish Snap.

Features music and sound effects!

![](/assets/projects/college/casino-val-u-pak/screenshot-3.webp)![](/assets/projects/college/casino-val-u-pak/screenshot-4.webp)![](/assets/projects/college/casino-val-u-pak/screenshot-5.webp)![](/assets/projects/college/casino-val-u-pak/screenshot-6.webp)In 2022, I built a small Windows [command prompt emulator](https://github.com/tjvezina/cmd-emulator) in **p5.js** so I could recreate this and other projects in a web context, and keep them alive and playable for longer.
